title: Opening of the interview at Tulane
summary: Dick Allen announces the date, place and participants.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Okay, we're doing an interview today at room 104, History Building, Tulane University. Let's see, today is July the 14th, 1960. And I'm going to get everybody's name here. What's your name then?

Paul Crawford. Dick Allen. Okay. That makes it easier for the secretary. She knows which voice is which. Almond, let me see. First thing I'd like to start with is just about you, when you were born and where exactly.
